name: com.pdfcheckup/pdf-checkup
title: PDF Checkup
description: Check a PDF for accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA and PDF/UA-1 (veraPDF) report with pages and fixes.

tools.name: check_pdf_accessibility
tools.description: Check a PDF at a public URL for accessibility problems: WCAG 2.1 AA checks (tags, title, language, alt text on images, link text, tab order, scanned pages without text, form fields, fonts) plus the full PDF/UA-1 machine-checkable rule set via veraPDF. Returns a score, each failing check with page numbers, how it can be fixed (auto / AI / manual / re-export from source) and document facts. Use it when a user asks whether a PDF is accessible, ADA / Section 508 / WCAG compliant, or what to fix. Free limits: 30 pages, 20 MB. Takes 5-30 seconds. The file is deleted after the check. Files on the user's device can't be sent here: send the user to https://pdfcheckup.com/ to upload.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the PDF file, e.g. "https://example.org/report.pdf".
